facts.text: The Aggie Pathway Program allows students to begin at an NMSU community college campus before transferring to the Las Cruces campus.

sources.title: About Aggie Pathway | New Mexico State University - BE BOLD. Shape the Future®
sources.quote: As an Aggie Pathway student, you will start at one of our four community college campuses, located in Alamogordo, Dona Ana County, or Grants.
